LAUNCH FAR BELOW: a balloon just lifting off a field, its envelope newly rounded and full, rising slowly above the long grass
BURNER FLARE: a short warm puff of light inside the envelope, briefly lighting its cloth from within and the basket below
RAIN FAR OFF: a soft grey fan of rain falling from one small cloud onto the fields far below and to the east
RAINBOW ARC: a soft banded arc standing over the far fields, its colours pale and wide against the grey beyond
SHADOW SLIDING: the vessel's soft shadow sliding slowly across the patchwork fields, crossing a lane and a pale hedgerow
KITE CLIMBING: a kite climbing away from a hill far below, its tail rising in a long gentle curve above the slope
ENVELOPE GLOW: the cloth glowing through for a moment as the burner catches, the weave lit amber from inside
PENNANT SNAP: a little pennant snapping over at the basket's rim, its bright tip lifting and settling in the soft air
RAIN VEIL: a pale rain veil hanging under a single cloud over the valley, touching the fields in a thin silver curtain
GLIDER TURNING: a glider just released and turning gently, its wings tilting as it finds the rising air above the ridge
SECOND RAINBOW: a faint second arc standing just outside the first, its bands reversed and soft against the dark cloud behind
CLOUD SHADOW: a cloud shadow crossing a hillside far below, moving slowly over the pale grass and the darker wood
BURNER PULSE: a soft warm pulse of light rising through the crown of the envelope, the cloth glowing briefly at the top
BALLOON FROM FOG: a balloon rising out of the fog below, its envelope newly visible and full above the grey layer
RAIN ON HILL: a soft rain fan touching one distant hill, the grey falling in a gentle angle across its upper slope
RIPPLE ALONG ENVELOPE: a ripple travelling along the envelope's side, the cloth lifting and settling in a slow easy motion
LOW RAINBOW: a short low arc of colour standing against a dark band of cloud over the far edge of the plain
FLAGS ON LINE: a handful of paper flags fluttering loose on a line below the basket, each one lifting and falling softly
AMBER CROWN: a gentle amber flare glowing up through the crown, the top of the envelope warm and bright for a moment
WING LIFTING: a wing lifting off a slope far below, rising on the air above the ridge in a slow and easy climb
ROUND SHADOW: the vessel's soft shadow crossing a pale field below, its edge soft on the dry summer ground
RAINBOW OVER FIELDS: a soft banded arc of colour rising over the fields to the west, standing clear against the grey air
BASKET LIT: a soft warm pulse lighting the basket and the inside of the envelope, the wicker briefly bright and golden
RAIN CLOUD FAN: a soft grey fan of rain falling from one small cloud, spreading wide across the quiet fields below
ENVELOPE RIPPLE CATCH: the cloth catching the low light for a moment, a ripple travelling gently from base to crown
